rationale: The candidate is a coherent compact mass in all four views, so repair integrity is strong, but it currently reads mostly as a generic box with a shallow notch rather than a neighborhood building with an active ground threshold and a usable public void. The blue access edge is acknowledged only weakly: the form does not open convincingly toward it, and the subtraction is too small to become a legible court or entry seam. The silhouette is stable but not program-revelatory; there is no convincing section logic, terrace, or folded roof response to support the neighborhood_living brief. It is not catastrophically fragmented or self-colliding, but it underperforms on publicness, hierarchy, and program fit. Because the visible mass does not yet express the required active-edge/public-space relationship, program_fit_hard_pass is false.
